positions.title: 2018 Venture For America Fellow
positions.description: Venture For America is a fellowship for recent grads who want to learn how to build a business while making an impact. VFA Fellows get training and join a startup in an emerging US city, where they live and work for two years at one of our hundreds of partner companies. They learn hands-on what it takes to build a company, while getting the mentorship, network, and ongoing support to prepare themselves to become successful entrepreneurs. Our goal is to spark job growth in cities that need it by sending our top-talent to help grow the businesses that will make it happen. Learn more at www.ventureforamerica.org.

positions.title: Product Engineer
positions.description:
- Led Black Knight's machine learning team to a 300% increase in accuracy through data extraction and improvements to document classification.
- Managed a team of engineers to build out a custom mortgage platform for one of the five largest banks in the US.
- Contributed to the software development of the mortgage platform, including authentication and authorization with Amazon Cognito, a loan search engine using ElasticSearch, and integration with Black Knight’s loan processing software.

positions.title: Research Assistant
positions.description: Produced statistical insights using Matlab and R for two pre-clinical research studies investigating neuromodulation techniques for treatment of autism.

positions.title: Editorial Intern
positions.description:
- Create original content – writing, photo essay, or video – for the online publication.
- Contribute to social media outlets throughout the week.
- Discover, attend, and promote cultural happenings in Baltimore. Upload relevant event details to the calendar, and help curate BmoreArt’s weekly picks for the Newsletter.

positions.title: Research Assistant
positions.description: Accumulated and analyzed data through running experiments with marmosets in Go/No-Go auditory tasks to investigate the neural basis of auditory perception and vocalizations, with a focus on plasticity in the auditory cortex.
